title: Tumski Bridge
scope: Tumski Bridge exterior: two open low lattice side girders, curved upper side chords and vertical hangers, one curved central overhead lattice portal, two open river spans over a cutwater pier, skewed bank bearings, separate outer walks, slim railings, two robed stone entrance statues on pedestals and paired gas lamps.
axis: +X crosses from Sand Island toward Cathedral Island, east-southeast; -X faces the paired entrance statues. +Z faces the southern river reach.

groundCutout.basis: Retained skew-ended bridge deck footprint only. Independent banks, roads and buildings remain native.

heightPolicy: Fixed 110 m datum and approximate 113.8 m deck. Standard terrain samples 110.150 m review water. Sculptures, steel sections, deck elevation and buried foundations are ordinary-photo approximations.
limitations: Fixed 110 m datum and approximate 113.8 m deck. Standard terrain samples 110.150 m review water. Sculptures, steel sections, deck elevation and buried foundations are ordinary-photo approximations.

No interiors, moving traffic, individual padlocks, readable inscriptions or exact sculptural likenesses. The two stone figures are modeled in the round as medium-fi exterior forms.
